patch.summary: Keap implementation guide: day-zero sequence, pilot rules, plan gates, and cutover checks from SoftwareGlimpse research — not generic CRM setup filler.

blocks.body: Implement Keap by mapping current crm workflows to Keap objects, confirming plan gates for premium capabilities, piloting one team, then cutting over integrations (Gmail, Stripe, PayPal) after data checks.
bullets: Gate check: confirm paid unlocks before go-live
Integrate after: data quality pass on Gmail

blocks.heading: Keap day-zero to steady-state sequence
blocks.body: Treat Keap setup as a controlled rollout — not a weekend dump of CSV files.

scenarios.title: Day zero — objects and owners
scenarios.body: Define owners for contact management, lead management, pipeline management before inviting the whole org.

scenarios.title: SMB pilot
scenarios.body: One pipeline / one team proves Small businesses needing CRM + marketing automation in one platform before company-wide seats.

scenarios.title: Cutover
scenarios.body: Freeze legacy writes briefly; validate Gmail and Stripe before reopen.

steps.label: Go when plan unlocks cover must-have capabilities
Pause if this limitation blocks ops: Base plans start at list price annually for two users; additional users are list price each.
Do not expand seats until contact management is green

items.title: Mistake 1
items.body: Base plans start at list price annually for two users; additional users are list price each.

items.title: Mistake 2
items.body: Contact capacity and voice/SMS allotments scale by Max tier; overages apply for texts/voice minutes.

items.title: Mistake 3
items.body: Annual contracts may include a documented early-termination fee (list price) if cancelled before term end.

items.title: Mistake 4
items.body: Not positioned as a lightweight pipeline-only CRM; buyers seeking Gmail-native or free forever CRM should compare Streak/Capsule.

items.title: Big-bang invite
items.body: Inviting every user before object design creates junk data that is expensive to unwind.

blocks.title: Keap plan gates that affect rollout
blocks.body: Implementation fails when unlocks needed for go-live sit on a higher tier than budgeted.

lines.label: Max Ignite
lines.description: Trial available · up to 2 included users · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, pipeline management · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

blocks.title: Validate crm fit before a deep Keap rollout
blocks.body: If Keap fails constraint fit, stop implementation early.

checklist.label: Draft Keap object owners before invites
Confirm plan unlocks for go-live features
Pilot one team on contact management
If blocked, evaluate Capsule before sunk-cost expansion
